summary: Iteration 19 — Vendor/Partner Activation (buyer default, instant supplier, designer form with private KTP/selfie, contractor form with workshop + survey schedule flow). Backend: 27/28 pytest passed, 1 skipped (bidding gate requires open projects for demo). Covered: demo login mapping (buyer/supplier_vendor/designer_creator/contractor/admin + legacy contractor_buyer alias), roles/switch 403 for gated roles / 200 for supplier_vendor, private upload RBAC (anon 401 / other 403 / owner & admin 200 / public anon 200), admin partner-verifications list+counts+non-admin 403+invalid role 400, designer activation requires private uploads (400 on public) + PENDING_DESIGNER_VERIFICATION on submit + admin approve, contractor activation validations (bad video ftp -> 400, missing lat/lng + no maps_url -> 400, address <10 -> 422), full contractor flow: submit -> PENDING_SURVEY_VERIFICATION, admin approve before schedule -> 400, reschedule before schedule -> 400, admin schedule -> SURVEY_SCHEDULED, contractor reschedule -> ok, admin re-schedule keeps survey_history & clears reschedule_request, admin approve after SURVEY_SCHEDULED -> VERIFIED, reject note <5 -> 422. Tim MatShop.id akan melakukan verifikasi dokumen dan menjadwalkan kunjungan/survei ke lokasi Workshop Anda.' Contractor dashboard tabs peluang/profil present. Admin UI: admin-tab-partners -> partner-verification-board, pv-role-designer_creator shows 'Desainer Pending (1)', pv-role-contractor shows 'Kontraktor Pending (2)' with counts; pv-filter-pending/-verified/-rejected/-all for designer, +pv-filter-scheduled for contractor (correct conditional per spec); pv-card-{uid} shows pv-ktp-, pv-selfie-, pv-video-, pv-maps- for contractor; pv-schedule-{id} opens form with pv-date-/pv-time-/pv-note-/pv-schedule-save-, after save card moves to scheduled filter and pv-approve-{id} becomes available. Seed restored to pristine state post-run.
action_items: Documentation only: /app/memory/test_credentials.md still describes legacy roles (contractor_buyer) prominently. The 'Roles update (2026-06)' section is already added at the bottom but main table at top is now outdated — consider cleaning for new agents.
critical_code_review_comments: partners.py:142 target() returns 404 when role_verifications[role] is absent — correct. schedule/reject/approve consistently use PENDING map plus allowed-transition checks (contractor approve requires SURVEY_SCHEDULED). Good.
partners.py:74 activate() preserves prev.survey and prev.survey_history when a user resubmits after rejection — correct for the 'Perbaiki & Kirim Ulang' flow.
server.py:447 /api/uploads uses `private: bool = False` query flag; path format `/{app}/private/{user_id}/{uuid}.ext` is checked by `/private/{user_id}/` substring in partners.check_private — robust.
server.py:470 serve_file for private checks viewer.user_id == owner_id OR is_admin — correct. get_user raises 401 when no token, so anon gets 401 (not 403) — matches spec.

custom_projects.py:259 submit_bid only checks `'contractor' in user.enabled_roles` and NOT verification_status — spec compliant (bidding allowed while PENDING, badge differs). vendor_verified is computed from role_verifications.contractor.status == 'VERIFIED' — correct per spec.
ActivationForm.jsx:24 valid flag requires maps_url.trim() OR lat != null; backend also enforces -> consistent.
PartnerVerificationBoard.jsx:112 pv-filter-scheduled only rendered when role='contractor' — correct, designer has no survey.

seed.py DEMO_USERS: user_demo_buyer has enabled_roles ['buyer'] only (upserts preserve admin edits — $setOnInsert vs $set on enabled_roles). Partners.seed_partners migrates legacy 'contractor_buyer' primary_role -> 'buyer' and adds 'buyer' to enabled_roles — correct backward compat.
Minor: partners.py:139 counts endpoint iterates with nested dict comprehension doing a DB query per (role,status) = 8 queries; fine at this scale but could be aggregated.
Minor: PartnerStatus RescheduleForm has no success/error toast after submit; relies on reschedule_request appearing. OK but UX could add toast.
